bulk-kind-clear-bookmarks-blurb: Permanent. The posts themselves are untouched.
bulk-kind-clear-history-blurb: Permanent. History rows are removed outright.
bulk-kind-delete-comments-blurb: Soft-deleted, so everything lands in the bin above and can be restored.
bulk-kind-delete-posts-blurb: Soft-deleted, so everything lands in the bin above and can be restored.
bulk-kind-unfollow-blurb: Permanent. Unfollowing cannot be undone from the bin.
cookie-consent-learn-aria: Learn more about our cookie policy
cookie-consent-text: We use essential cookies to run the site and privacy-friendly analytics to improve it.
cookie-consent-text-ads: We use essential cookies to run the site, privacy-friendly analytics to improve it, and advertising cookies to fund it. Choosing “Essential only” keeps the ads but stops them being personalised.
notFound.body: The page you’re looking for doesn’t exist, moved, or never did. Let’s get you back on track.
notFound.title: Page not found
offline-body: RMH Studios needs a connection for this page. Check your network and try again.
trash-reason-expired: The recovery window for this has passed.
trash-reason-moderated: This was removed by a moderator and cannot be restored.
trash-reason-not-deleted: This is not deleted, so there is nothing to restore.
trash-reason-not-found: This is no longer in the database — it has already been permanently deleted.
trash-reason-not-owner: This is not yours to restore.
trash-reason-parent-deleted: The post this replied to is also deleted. Restore that one first.
trash-reason-parent-missing: The post this replied to no longer exists.
